examples.english: for it is written, 'My son, I have always shewn myself glad to accompany the man who came to walk.'

examples.coptic: ϫⲉⲙⲛϭⲉ ⲟⲩⲟⲉⲓϣ ϭⲉ ⲛⲁϣⲱⲡⲉ . ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ϩⲣⲁⲓ ϩⲛⲛⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲛⲧⲉⲥⲙⲏ ⲙⲡⲙⲉϩⲥⲁϣϥ ⲛⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ **ⲉϥϣⲁⲛⲛⲟⲩ **ⲉ**ⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲍⲉ** ϥⲛⲁϫⲱⲕ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛϭⲓⲡⲙⲏⲥⲧⲩⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲙⲡⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉ ⲛⲧϩⲉ ⲛⲧⲁϥⲉⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲍⲉ ⲛⲛⲉϥϩⲙϩⲁⲗ ⲙⲛⲛⲉⲡⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ .
examples.english: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants, the prophets.

examples.english: But when I speak to thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say to them, Thus saith the Lord, He that hears, let him hear; and he that is disobedient, let him be disobedient: because it is a provoking house.
